meaning:
πορεία, -ας, ἡ
(πορεύω), [in LXX chiefly for הֲלִיכָה and cogn. forms ;]
1. a journey: Luk.13:22.
2. a going: metaphorically ("the rich man perishes while he is still on the move," Hort., in l), Jas.1:11.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: He went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and traveling on to Jerusalem.
